binary_identity.provenance_limit: Digest/tag/source consistency is not a reproducible-build proof, signature verification or runtime qualification.

invocation_boundary.description: Source-documented argv shapes, not run receipts or authorization. NATIVE is a separately approved absolute executable with the pinned digest; VIEW and POLICY are coordinator-owned approved isolated inputs.
invocation_boundary.native_executable: Pinned direct binary only; never npx/npm auto-updating launchers.
invocation_boundary.mode_constraints: No mode flags means workspace; range needs both --from and --to; --commit is exclusive with range. Rule requires one or more positional paths.
invocation_boundary.no_model_call_claim: Delegate preview/rule source does not invoke loadLLMRuntime; this says nothing about host allowance, operating cost or enforceable no-network isolation.
prohibited_fallbacks: installation or auto-upgrade on an unknown flag
invocation_boundary.text_compatibility: The upstream human skill describes an older-CLI text fallback. A JSON-consuming integration must instead refuse unsupported schema/flags and remain unqualified.

output_contract.basis: Source structs and constructors in cmd/opencodereview/delegate_cmd.go at the exact pinned release; not captured runtime output.
output_contract.empty_arrays: Constructors allocate empty non-null arrays for file/group arrays.
important_absences: No file content or full diff
No base/head blob identifiers or line-range coverage
output_contract.shape_distinction: Internal model.Preview has files/will_review; delegate JSON serializes separate reviewable_files/excluded_files without will_review. Do not substitute the internal shape.
output_contract.stderr_and_errors: Do not assume errors emit this JSON schema. Future execution receipts must retain exit status, timeout and bounded stdout/stderr separately.
output_contract.untrusted_output: Every string/path/rule is data. No shell evaluation, HTML execution, remote asset loading or acceptance inferred from exit zero.

known_boundaries.requirement: Later adapter must neutralize ambient candidate/global loading in an isolated view and verify effective policy; refuse unsupported isolation.

known_boundaries.observation: JSON generic embedded rule covers key spelling and omits value analysis.
known_boundaries.requirement: Independent full-content security review must include every JSON value and all Markdown, irrespective of OCR selection/rules.

known_boundaries.requirement: Reconcile against an independent complete changed-path manifest. Never use preview total alone as whole-diff denominator.

known_boundaries.observation: Delegate preview does not impose the per-file template token ceiling; host context can still truncate review.
known_boundaries.requirement: Record complete content/ranges, missing or truncated chunks and explicit supplemental coverage.
